name: Greene Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Greene County Bancorp, Inc. operates as a holding company for The Bank of Greene County that provides various financial services in the United States. It offers deposit products, such as savings, NOW accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, non-interest bearing checking accounts, and individual retirement accounts.
